newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faulding wins iopamidol FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faulding wins iopamidol FDA approval.

text.p: Pharmaceutical company F.H. Faulding & Co Ltd said on Thursday its U.S.-based subsidiary Faulding Inc has received U.S. Food and Drug Adminstration approval to market iopamidol, an injectable contrast media.
Iopamidol is injected into the vascular system and is used for angiography, urography, and contrast enhancement of computed tomographic head and body imaging, Faulding said.

Faulding said its 61 percent and 76 percent solutions of iopamidol injection were the generic equivalent of branded products. Faulding said having received one of the first generic approvals for iopamidol injection, it would be able to play a role in the creation of the generic market for the product.
